title: Continuous conormal sequence for a formal power-series quotient
statement: Let $F$ be a field, $n\ge0$, $D=F[[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] with $\mathfrak n=(t_1,\ldots,t_n)$, let $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_s)\subseteq\mathfrak n$, and put $R=D/I$ and $\mathfrak n_R=\mathfrak nR$. Set $\widehat\Omega_{D/F}=\varprojlim_r\Omega_{(D/\mathfrak n^r)/F}$ and $\widehat\Omega_{R/F}=\varprojlim_r\Omega_{(R/\mathfrak n_R^r)/F}$ using [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], with transition maps induced by quotient maps. For $B=D$ or $R$, let $\widehat{\mathrm d}_B:B\to\widehat\Omega_{B/F}$ be $b\mapsto(\mathrm d(b\bmod\mathfrak n_B^r))_r$, where $\mathfrak n_D=\mathfrak n$; write $\widehat{\mathrm d}$ with its domain understood. Then the sequence of $R$-modules $$R^{\oplus s}\longrightarrow\widehat\Omega_{D/F}\otimes_D R\longrightarrow\widehat\Omega_{R/F}\longrightarrow0$$ is exact, where the first map sends the $j$-th basis vector to the image of $\widehat{\mathrm d}(f_j)$ and the second sends $\widehat{\mathrm d}(h)\otimes\bar a$ to $\bar a\,\widehat{\mathrm d}(h\bmod I)$.
